subject: ss-plastic-surgery
title: Lymphedema: ISL Staging, LVA, VLNT and Debulking

steps.say: Swelling that pits and vanishes overnight is staging differently from woody elephantiasis. Stage zero is hiding impaired transport without visible swelling, stage one is pitting reversibly, and stage two is turning fibrotic and irreversible. Stage three is ending in warty lymphostatic elephantiasis.
steps.tx: The **ISL classification** stages lymphedema: **Stage 0** subclinical without swelling, **Stage 1** reversible pitting edema, **Stage 2** irreversible non-pitting fibrotic edema, and **Stage 3** lymphostatic **elephantiasis**. Pitting that elevates away marks early disease, while woody fibrosis marks late. Stage assignment is directing every treatment choice that follows.

steps.say: Blind surgery on dead channels is wasting the operation before it begins. Indocyanine green dye traced by near-infrared cameras is mapping the functional dermal lymphatics live. Linear patterns are marking healthy channels while splash, stardust, and diffuse backflow are flagging failure zones.
steps.tx: **Indocyanine green (ICG) lymphography** with near-infrared imaging maps functional **dermal lymphatics**. Linear means normal, while splash, stardust, and diffuse **dermal backflow** mark progressive failure. The map is directing incisions onto living channels and steering every cut away from dead zones.

steps.say: Hair-thin lymphatics are joining neighbouring venules under extreme magnification. Channels of only zero point three to zero point eight millimetres are opening directly into low-pressure veins. Lymph is draining downhill into the venous system through connections finer than a human hair.
steps.tx: **Lymphovenous anastomosis (LVA)** **supermicrosurgery** joins subdermal lymphatic channels of **0.3 to 0.8 mm** to adjacent venules under high-power microscopy. The bank figure shows obstructed lymphatics with fibrosis beside the stitched **anastomosis**. Tiny lumens drain steadily into low-pressure veins, bypassing the blocked trunks entirely.

vis.alt: Swollen leg with obstructed lymphatics and dermal fibrosis beside a microsurgical lymphovenous anastomosis joining a lymphatic to a venule.
vis.caption: Lymphoedema with fibrosis and LVA bypass. Sizes and timing are in the text, not on the drawing (StewardMD).

steps.say: Sclerosed cords are accepting no stitch however skilled the surgeon may be. Early stage one and early stage two vessels are keeping contractility with patent lumens. Severe intraluminal sclerosis is turning channels into fibrous cords that cannot be revived.
steps.tx: **LVA efficacy** peaks in early disease: **Stage 1** and early **Stage 2** vessels keep contractility with patent lumens. Severe **intraluminal sclerosis** makes cords ungraftable. Operating while the channels still pump is deciding success long before the first stitch is placed.

steps.say: Limbs with no usable channels are importing whole lymph node basins instead. Supraclavicular, omental, or lateral thoracic packets with their own blood supply are transplanting microvascularly into the swollen extremity. New drainage is growing from the implanted living tissue.
steps.tx: **Vascularized lymph node transfer (VLNT)** microvascularly transplants node basins such as **supraclavicular**, omental, or lateral thoracic into the limb. The packet arrives with its own **blood supply**. Imported nodes reseed drainage where no local channel survives the fibrotic process. Donor-site lymphedema stays rare with careful basin choice.

steps.say: Implanted nodes are working as factories and sponges at once. Vascular endothelial growth factor C secreted by the nodes is sprouting fresh lymphatic channels. A pump-sponge mechanism is wicking pooled lymph into the venous circulation through the flap vessels.
steps.tx: **VLNT** works through **lymphangiogenesis** driven by **VEGF-C** secretion plus an internal pump-sponge shunting lymph into veins. New channels sprout while pooled fluid wicks away. The transferred nodes act as both factory and pump inside the swollen limb together. Dual action explains results that plumbing alone cannot match.

steps.say: Woody fat-laden limbs are needing volume removal rather than new plumbing. Circumferential suction-assisted lipectomy under tourniquet control is extracting litres of fibro-adipose tissue through small incisions. Late stage two and stage three elephantiasis are shrinking as the diseased fat leaves.
steps.tx: Late fibro-adipose disease takes debulking: circumferential **suction-assisted lipectomy** under **tourniquet** control for late **Stage 2** and **Stage 3**. Litres of **fibro-adipose deposition** leave through small incisions. New plumbing cannot fix limbs that are mostly fat and fibrosis rather than fluid.

steps.say: Purplish nodules erupting in decades-old swelling are signalling a deadly transformation. Stewart-Treves lymphangiosarcoma is arising in long-standing lymphoedematous limbs with terrifying speed. Five-year survival under fifteen percent is making radical treatment urgent at the first suspicious lesion.
steps.tx: **Stewart-Treves syndrome** is rare aggressive **lymphangiosarcoma** in chronic lymphedematous extremities. Purplish nodules erupt after years of swelling. **5-year** survival under **15%** makes biopsy of any suspicious lesion urgent, with radical surgery following fast once histology confirms the sarcoma. Amputation with radiotherapy follows when excision cannot clear disease.
